Speed 20 feet

AC +2 item

Melee thorn-arm (agile, reach 10 ft) 2d6 piercing

Skills +2 circumstance to Grapple and to resist forced movement

Green load 10 temporary Hit Points, renewing each round while the needle stays on Green. Grey load thorn-arm deals an additional 1d6 persistent bleed, and creatures that Grapple you or hit you with an unarmed attack take 1d6 persistent bleed.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same `BLIGHTSHAPE-NULL` + `BLOOMROT-NULL` blockers as the other two forms. The Green load's "10 temp HP renewing each round" is itself a real, clean shape once a home exists for it (`TempHP` inside a `BattleForm` override, similar to Aerial Form's `tempHP` bracket field) — flagged as the cleanest of the three forms to build first if a companion effect file is ever authored.
